page.overview:
What is Orders of the Knight Radiance?

The Knights Radiance is a legion of Knights with different abilities and spren that aid them. With the bond of a spren the Knight Radiant is able to be given Surgebinding abilities. The Radiance is divided into 10 different orders each have 5 different ordeals they have to speak in order to be given there full potential. The first ordeal is the same for each order: Life before death, strength before weakness, journey before destination. Each Order has 4 unique ordeals, accept for Lightweavers who only have the first ordeal. Each order has its own glyph used to illustrate it.

Lightweavers are surgers of Illumination and Transformation. They are known to inspire others to become the best versions of themselves. They differ in personality but they all are united in a love for art, although some are more into things such as espionage. Lightweavers are the spies for the Knights Radiance. Lightweavers end to have looser morals then the other orders, but have firm beliefs at the same time.

Lightweavers are an oddity among the other orders, because instead of speaking a specific phrase or holding a specific theme, the Ordeals differ for each person. The Lightweaver's ordeals are a series of truths that they speak about themselves-things they must admit to themselves in order to progress. "It is theorized that because Lightweavers live on the line between reality and fiction, it is important for them to be able to separate the real from the lie, and only with the proper ability to do so can they move forward.-[https://www.brandonsanderson.com/the-ten-orders-of-knights-radiant/ Brandon Sanderson's Website]

Elsecallers surge the ablilities of Transformation and Transportation. They include all different types of characters as long as they wish to progress, the Elsecaller's theme. The Elsecallers are known to thoughtful and cautious, known as the wisest among the radiance, often being the tactians and logistical geniuses. The order is made up of lots of scholars, but also includes theologians and people interested in leadership. They are good at encouraging others, but some are known to set their sights upon the things they want and then seize them.
